checks.name: Point-buy dropdowns enforce 27 points; valid permanent build saves and updates real attributes
Initial Origin feat is chosen through the real control and saved separately from ASI
All 18 skills render; fighter selects 2 class and 2 background proficiencies with computed bonuses
At Bractwo 15 the level 4 D&D choice increases Strength +2 and consumes one shared feat choice
Fighter extra level 25 choice supports split +1/+1 and respects the 20 cap
Six main tabs separate Abilities and Feats; seven Stats categories render only the selected information
Feats Class retains fighter style and martial choices; general Feats does not duplicate ASI controls
World E interaction resolves a real seeded D20 check and awards gold once; duplicate request gives no second reward
Unlocked route remains usable in reverse through the Skills panel without another reward
Existing character receives an unspent development reminder after login; its button opens ability growth
Spending the available development choice removes the reminder
Mobile Skills panel exposes Hide with explicit PvE-only visibility explanation
Build,origin,proficiencies,ASI and challenge claims survive reconnect; skills and stats fit 390px
Wizard Scholar expertise unlocks at Bractwo 5, doubles proficiency, and choices fit 320px
No browser JavaScript errors or missing local assets

limits: Isolated in-memory database, explicit fake Google provider, fixture-granted levels/gold/location, seeded RNG and paused monster AI. Real character choices, skill checks and persistence handlers execute unchanged.
Headless Chromium desktop 1440x900, touch 390x844 and touch 320x568; real Google accounts, physical phones and Railway deployment are not covered.
Browser tests cover actual controls, 27-point ability build, proficiency choices,ASI, one-time rewards, reconnect persistence and layout. Broader rule correctness belongs to Python tests.
